3.text: The ballot accounting gives 593 ballots received: 249 mail, 270 online and 74 in person.

16.text: The certification includes a short reply addressed to Luis Banuelos that answers both of his points, the exchange-area challenge and the blank-position ballots, and can be sent as written.

17.text: The certification includes a short reply addressed to Sarah Moore stating that her ballot arrived after the 5:00 p.m. 18 September deadline and could not be counted, and that the postmark does not change this.

18.text: Stage 2 of the stage table transfers Ostrander's 4.0000 surplus, leaving Ostrander 142.0000, Kessler 112.2386, Banuelos 95.8190, Okafor 66.4095 and non-transferable 0.5329.

19.text: Stages 3 and 4 of the stage table exclude Pyle on 10.0000 and then Tremblay on 15.0000, leaving Szabo, Wendling and Brandt on 28.0000 each, Hargrove on 65.0000 and non-transferable on 1.5329.

criteria_add.text: The certification is addressed to the Board of Directors from the Election Committee.

The ballot accounting gives 5 void ballots and 21 rejected ballots, 8 of the rejections being duplicates: 3 mail ballots replaced by the same member's in-person ballot and 5 later ballots from members whose first valid ballot counts.
Stages 5 to 7 of the stage table exclude Brandt, Wendling and Szabo in turn, leaving Kessler on 124.2386, Banuelos on 105.8190, Hargrove on 98.0000, Okafor on 92.4095 and non-transferable on 4.5329.
